title: Confirm expedited shipping
description: Reach out to logistics to confirm faster delivery is feasible.

title: Review credit limit
description: Escalate to finance to review the customer's credit limit.

title: Send warranty offer
description: Prepare and send an extended warranty upsell offer to the customer.

description: Inform the customer about the two separate delivery dates.

title: Request payment guarantee
description: Ask sales rep to secure a payment guarantee before shipment.
